    KonceptPatternListBlockMacro - Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    AsciidoctorJ block macro processor that renders a "List of Patterns": a flat, numbered index of every kind: pattern koncept in the definition source, alphabetical by label, each entry a plain link to that pattern's own entry in the Koncept Glossary — no columns, no icons, styled the same as the document's own table of contents (ul.sectlevel1) rather than as a data table.
    KonceptPatternListBlockMacro() - Constructor for class network.ike.docs.koncept.KonceptPatternListBlockMacro
    Creates a new block macro processor instance.
    KonceptPatternTableBlockMacro - Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    AsciidoctorJ block macro processor that renders a kind: pattern koncept's shape as a real, captioned AsciiDoc table — one Model Feature (the referenced component, then each declared field in order) per three-row group (IKE-Network/ike-issues#883).
    KonceptPatternTableBlockMacro() - Constructor for class network.ike.docs.koncept.KonceptPatternTableBlockMacro
    Creates a new block macro processor instance.
    KonceptSigilInlineMacro - Class in network.ike.docs.koncept
    AsciidoctorJ inline macro that renders a component-kind sigil on its own — the mark a Koncept Badge carries for its kind, without any badge around it — so prose that talks about the sigil scheme (a "How to Read This Guide" front matter, a tutorial) can show the real marks instead of describing them.
    KonceptSigilInlineMacro() - Constructor for class network.ike.docs.koncept.KonceptSigilInlineMacro
    Creates a new inline macro processor instance.

    KonceptSvgRenderer - Class in network.ike.docs.koncept

    render(String, String, KonceptKind) - Static method in class network.ike.docs.koncept.KonceptSvgRenderer
    Render an inline SVG badge for a Koncept reference, honest about its kind.
    render(String, String, KonceptKind, boolean) - Static method in class network.ike.docs.koncept.KonceptSvgRenderer
    Render an inline SVG badge for a Koncept reference — the no-computable-identity fallback, converged to the identicon-pill look (ike-issues#864): the spec's light pill, the small-caps IKE-blue label (struck through in the retired colour when inactive), and the leading kind sigil — no more solid-blue box, white text, or K prefix.
    renderSigil(KonceptKind) - Static method in class network.ike.docs.koncept.KonceptSvgRenderer
    Render a component-kind sigil on its own at natural badge scale — see KonceptSvgRenderer.renderSigil(KonceptKind, double).
    renderSigil(KonceptKind, double) - Static method in class network.ike.docs.koncept.KonceptSvgRenderer
    Render a component-kind sigil on its own — no badge, no anchor, no name — as standalone inline SVG from the same locked constants the badge renderers use (KonceptKind's glyph/colour data and the StampSigilGeometry pentagon), so a sigil shown in prose can never drift from the sigil shown in a badge.
    renderStampSigil(String, String) - Static method in class network.ike.docs.koncept.KonceptSvgRenderer
    Render a STAMP badge without an identicon — the no-computable-identity fallback (the identicon-bearing stamp chip is KonceptInlineMacro#renderHtmlStampChip): the locked gray pentagon (computed from the shared StampSigilGeometry) as inline SVG — five asymmetric reading dots and a centre hub — beside the compact provenance text that stands in place of a name.
    renderStampSpecimen(String) - Static method in class network.ike.docs.koncept.KonceptSvgRenderer
    Render a stamp chip as a specimen — the pentagon and compact provenance text, exactly as KonceptSvgRenderer.renderStampSigil(String, String) draws them, but with no anchor: for prose that shows what a stamp badge looks like (a "How to Read This Guide" front matter) rather than referencing a glossary-curated component.

    type5(UUID, String) - Static method in class network.ike.docs.koncept.SnomedUuids
    Computes an RFC 4122 Type-5 (name-based, SHA-1) UUID, byte-for-byte compatible with UuidT5Generator.getUuidWithEncoding(namespace, name, "UTF-8"): SHA-1 over the namespace's 16 raw bytes followed by the UTF-8 bytes of the name, with the version and IETF variant bits set.
